English.Char_Desc_450: Review YouTube creator analytics in a private Windows workspace. By Aurelio Avila. Review limitations and access requirements on the official product page. Windows downloads are publisher-signed and timestamped; signing is not a safety guarantee. Screenshots illustrate the app and may show an earlier release.
English.Char_Desc_2000: Redexa Social by Aurelio Avila is a YouTube-first analytics workspace for Windows. Review connected-account metrics with local storage and read-only platform access. Instagram and TikTok require your own approved developer applications; X analytics are unavailable. Platform permissions and API limits still apply. Free and paid plans are described on the official website. The current Windows package is a signed-binary ZIP, not a standalone setup EXE; follow the official getting-started instructions. Publisher signatures and a signed update manifest are verified for the current package. Signing does not guarantee safety. The screenshot is an earlier genuine interface capture, not proof of current account data.
